chief_complaint.chief_complaint: Requesting extraction of upper right back teeth

oral_examination.oral_examination: 16 The buccal gingiva has receded to the root tip, and all the buccal roots are exposed. The gingiva is red, swollen, and 1 degree loose. CBCT shows that 16 has a large buccal bone defect.

treatment_plan.notes: Avoid acidic foods within a week and avoid hot and cold stimulation. Maintain oral hygiene as directed by your doctor and rinse with mouthwash. Regular re-examination and follow-up treatment if any discomfort occurs.

source_handle: 16. Extraction was performed under local anesthesia with articaine, and the alveolar socket was scratched and compressed to stop bleeding.
